pick.headline: Israel and the PLO sign the Oslo Declaration of Principles
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of September 15, 1993, carried an interview with Sa'ib Urayqat, who called direct PLO-Israel talks historic but judged the autonomy agreement "far too vague," warning that real negotiations would begin only after the Washington signing.
